ja: 『新機動戦記ガンダムＷ』より、ＭＧ 1/100 トールギスIIが早くもキット化！！
トールギスIIの特徴をマスターグレードで徹底再現!！
●新規パーツで、頭部形状、設定色を忠実に再現！
●ドーバーガンの砲身伸縮ギミックで、印象的なシーンを再現可能！
地面に銃を設置させて手で支えるポーズに適した長さに、砲身の長さを固定可能。
●新規のフィギュア付属！
トレーズ・クシュリナーダ、レディ・アンの立ちフィギュア、トレーズ・クシュリナーダのパイロットフィギュア

en: From "Mobile Suit Gundam W", MG 1/100 Tallgeese II is already available as a kit! !
The features of Tallgeese II are thoroughly reproduced in master grade!!
- Faithfully reproduce the head shape and set color with new parts!
-Dover gun's barrel extension gimmick allows you to recreate impressive scenes!
The length of the gun barrel can be fixed to a length suitable for a pose where the gun is placed on the ground and supported with the hands.
-New figure included!
Treize Kushrinada, Lady Anne standing figure, Treize Kushrinada pilot figure
- Water transfer Tallgeese II exclusive marking decal included!
Attached weapons: Dover gun, beam saber
1/100 Scale Assembly plastic model
Target age: 15 years old or older
Main product materials: PS, PE, ABS
・No adhesive is used for assembly
*The finished product in the photo is a prototype that is still under development.
